intent: Adjusted sensor x-positions outward by ±0.01 m to better cover sharp turns on the slalom track and added a sixth sensor at the center front to improve line detection in challenging sections. Reduced kp from 8 to 6 to smooth steering control and reduce oscillation. Expect improved finish rates and fewer line loss events on slalom, while maintaining strong performance on oval and s-bend tracks.
rationale: The previous iteration's geometry and control adjustments improved line coverage and early detection, reducing line loss events on oval and s-bend tracks. However, the slalom track still shows very low finish rates and relatively high steering oscillation, indicating challenges with sharp turns and control stability. Integration feedback recommends further fine-tuning of sensor lateral positions and control gains to address these issues. To better cover sharp turns, I will adjust sensor x-coordinates by ±0.01 m outward, increasing lateral coverage. Additionally, I will add a sixth sensor near the center front (x=0, y=0.07) to improve line detection in challenging sections. I will keep the sensor size at 0.016 m and maintain the forward y-positions to preserve early detection benefits. I will also reduce the proportional gain kp from 8 to 6 to smooth steering control and reduce oscillation, as prior evidence shows lower kp can help with control stability. Other geometry parameters remain unchanged to maintain stability and handling. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillation and line loss events on the slalom track, improve finish rates, and maintain strong performance on oval and s-bend tracks.
